description: The data of a state.changed event: an Axiom monitor triggered.

old.description: The state of the previous event of the monitor, or null.

new.description: open when the monitor triggered, closed when it resolved.

type.description: The monitor type, for example Threshold or MatchEvent.

query.description: The APL query of the monitor.

at.description: The time of the check, as Axiom gives it.
